programme.desc: For the past 2 years Nancy has been in an online relationship with "Shaun" she says is an honest and loving man. Her son Darcy says Nancy doesn't even know what he looks like! Nancy is adamant she is not being scammed in this catfish story of online love.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Jenaye posted an emotional video online about uncovering her husband James's infidelity she never imagined it would go viral. Discovering James slept with his hairstylist on their fifth anniversary, Jenaye says divorce might be the best option.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany claims dad Charlie is scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie has given over $25K while "Stephanie" maintains a $4.5 million inheritance is coming. The investigation starts in Los Angeles and ends in Denmark!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil welcomes controversial YouTuber "Agent Sebastian" who runs a page called "Cart Narcs" posting hundreds of explosive videos apprehending shoppers in parking lots who do not return their carts to the corrals. Is "Agent Sebastian" breaking the law?

programme.title: Theodore Ushev Unseen Connections
programme.desc: Theodore Ushev, the auteur behind a number of renowned animated shorts, reveals his inner universe, formed by a half-century of personal experience acquired in a constantly changing world.

programme.title: Best Time Of My Life Portraits Of Women In Mid-Life, The
programme.desc: An upbeat, positive film about a group of women dealing with mid-life and menopause. The women come from a wide range of backgrounds, careers and lifestyles, it effectively dispels popular myths and fears about life during and after menopause.

programme.title: Hands Of History
programme.desc: In this acclaimed 1994 documentary, Loretta Todd, a leading figure in Indigenous cinema in Canada, profiles four contemporary female artists.The film is a moving testimony to the vital role Indigenous women play in nurturing Indigenous cultures.

programme.title: Mary Two-Axe Earley I Am Indian Again
programme.desc: This film shares the powerful story of Mary Two-Axe Earley, who fought for more than two decades to challenge sex discrimination against First Nations women embedded in Canada’s Indian Act and became a key figure in Canada’s women’s rights movement.

programme.title: How They Saw Us Is It A Womans World
programme.desc: This film, made especially for television in 1956, embodies the conventional myth that women indirectly exercise power through their ability to manipulate men through sex and marriage.

programme.title: Proudest Girl In The World, The
programme.desc: A musical recruiting film for the Canadian Women's Army Corp.

programme.title: Burning Times, The
programme.desc: This film is an in-depth look at the witch-hunts that swept through Europe just a few hundred years ago. False accusations and trials led to massive torture and burnings at the stake, and ultimately to the destruction of an organic way of life.

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: Series hosted by Ben Shephard, Rochelle Humes and Chris Kamara. Competitors from all over the country take on TV's toughest obstacle course. Who will rise to the challenge, conquer Mount Midoriyama and be the UK's first Ninja Warrior?

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: Ben Shephard, Rochelle Humes and Chris Kamara host the final of the assault course game show. Who will conquer Mount Midoriyama and be crowned the UK's first Ninja Warrior?

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Teams in the first week of qualifications are led by Joe Moravsky and Jessie Graf.

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The NorCal Ninjas, led by team captain David Campbell, take on formidable foes featuring Ian Dory and Meagan Martin.

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Brent Steffensen and Kacy Catanzaro lead Team Alpha; Kevin Bull serves as captain of the Expendabulls; other competitors include Ryan Stratis and his team, Stratisfaction, and Tremayne Dortch and the Tre Amigoz.

programme.title: Bloomberg Investigates
programme.desc: Fake permits, undercover informants and millions of dollars are involved; a US government agency works to prove suppliers to research labs import wild monkeys from Cambodia with false paperwork.

programme.title: The Deal With Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly
programme.desc: Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly sit with Georgia Tech Athletics Director J Batt during March Madness to discuss the buzz around college athletics, including NIL and the transfer portal.

programme.title: Quantum Marketing
programme.desc: As marketers try to reach customers more effectively, some are investigating the inner workings of the brain. We speak with Pranav Yadav, CEO of Neuro-Insight, about the marketing intelligence his company is gleaning from neuroscience.

programme.title: Bloomberg Chief Future Officer
programme.desc: Duolingo CFO Matt Skaruppa has the world's leading language-learning app, poised for a new phase of growth powered by AI.

programme.title: Bloomberg Investigates
programme.desc: The demand for human eggs is booming, giving rise to a largely unregulated and dangerous marketplace; in India, meeting a teenage girl caught up in this fertility underworld.

programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: Emily Chang goes inside Stargate, an historic $500 billion bet on the future of AI; she speaks with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Softbank CEO Masayoshi Son about their hopes for the project.

programme.title: Bloomberg Originals
programme.desc: Experts offer bold takes on some of today's most important topics and cover stories and investigations at the intersection of business and culture.

programme.title: Bloomberg Wall Street Week
programme.desc: A weekly program telling the stories of capitalism from around the world, David Westin in New York hosts.

programme.desc: After 21 years, Paula is considering divorcing husband, Jeremy, saying he's "clueless, absent & non-verbal." Jeremy says it's Paula--controlling & a grudge-holder. Find out Jeremy's mistake. Dr. Phil and Robin share the secret to their 45-year marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tammy & Mark say they haven't spoken to their son, Cory, in a year as his wife, Katrina, is literally-- a witch! Katrina, a self-proclaimed "witch," says her inlaw's judge. Cory denies his wife controls him & he's against the poor treatment of his wife.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Nancy, who adamantly denies her online love relationship with "Shaun" is a scam. Nancy and her son Darcy speak face-to-face for the first time in over a year. Plus updates from past catfished guests!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Sandi, 60, discussing her online relationship with Peter, 22. Dr. Phil speaks to Peter in Nigeria via satellite & he insists he loves Sandi. Will Sandi listen to her daughters' concerns, or will she fly to Nigeria to marry Peter?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jenaye comes face-to-face for the first time with the woman her husband, James, slept with on their fifth wedding anniversary. The woman, Chelsey, who is also James's former hairstylist, tells her side of the story. Will Jenaye believe Chelsey's claims?

programme.title: Burning Times, The
programme.desc: This film is an in-depth look at the witch-hunts that swept through Europe just a few hundred years ago. False accusations and trials led to massive torture and burnings at the stake, and ultimately to the destruction of an organic way of life.

programme.title: Sea Dream
programme.desc: Children, like adults, have days that go wrong. This film shows how one little girl overcomes the day's frustrations by diving into an underwater fantasy where she spends time with her friend, the lady octopus.

programme.title: Benoit
programme.desc: Benoît is an astonishingly accomplished eleven-year-old Québécois from Joliette. He pursues such diverse activities as weight lifting and playing the violin.

programme.title: Cornet At Night
programme.desc: This film recalls rural life on the Prairies in the 1930s. A farmer's young son, sent to town to hire a man for the harvest, readily accepts when an itinerant trumpet player, down on his luck, begs a chance.

programme.title: Christophers Movie Matinee
programme.desc: When movie cameras were put in the hands of a few young people, they made this film about themselves and their world. The film is revealing in what it shows of a dissenting generation and its rationale.

programme.title: Lay Down Your Heart
programme.desc: An accomplished artist, a lifelong performer and a person with Down syndrome, Niall McNeil has built a unique family tree of blood and chosen relations made up of his closest friends and collaborators.

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Brent Steffensen and Kacy Catanzaro lead Team Alpha; Kevin Bull serves as captain of the Expendabulls; other competitors include Ryan Stratis and his team, Stratisfaction, and Tremayne Dortch and the Tre Amigoz.

programme.title: Team Ninja Warrior

programme.desc: Lai-wing tells Hei-man what happened; Hei-man says if Mei-kei is doing it intentionally, this may cause great harm to his parents' relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jenaye comes face-to-face for the first time with the woman her husband, James, slept with on their fifth wedding anniversary. The woman, Chelsey, who is also James's former hairstylist, tells her side of the story. Will Jenaye believe Chelsey's claims?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Brittany who says dad Charlie is being scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie hopes to get married when they meet in person. The real women in the photos are on stage & Charlie goes face-to-face!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There have been no answers to the whereabouts of Summer Wells, 5, missing since 2021. Parents Don & Candus say it backfired by requesting the public's help. In this exclusive first national TV interview, Dr. Phil digs deeper into the story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father pleads for help regarding his missing daughter. Gabby Petito, 22, set off on a van trip with her fiancé, but two months later he returned alone. Police revealed the couple had an incident--caught on camera. Gabby's dad is determined to find her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do "van life" blogger Gabby Petito's videos reveal what might have happened? TV host Nancy Grace, a former law enforcement officer & FBI defense tactics instructor, a criminal defense attorney & a body language expert all weigh in on the unusual details.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After another mass shooting in America, the elementary school in Uvalde, Texas where 2 teachers and 19 children were killed, Dr. Phil dedicates the show to speaking out about how these senseless acts of murder need to end and the importantance of change.

programme.title: Lay Down Your Heart
programme.desc: An accomplished artist, a lifelong performer and a person with Down syndrome, Niall McNeil has built a unique family tree of blood and chosen relations made up of his closest friends and collaborators.

programme.title: Chile Obstinate Memory
programme.desc: A generation of young Chileans has grown up with no knowledge of the facts surrounding the military coup of September 11, 1973. Now, Patricio Guzmán returns to Chile, after 23 years. The time has come to reveal the long-forgotten truth.

programme.title: Nails
programme.desc: A blacksmith is seen labouring at his forge, shaping nails from single strands of steel rods. It then shifts from this setting to the roar of a twentieth-century nail mill, where machines, cut, and pound the steel rods faster than the eye can follow.

programme.title: Return Home
